summary: W1 does not pass round 1 because of one blocker. The vendor API key that originality F1 is about is still in two tracked files at HEAD, and the branch is pushed. Those files are compiled Python bytecode: pipeline/__pycache__/meshy_anims.cpython-313.pyc and meshy_chars_img.cpython-313.pyc, committed 07-10 in 5bf0f7cc and tracked even though .gitignore:127 now ignores __pycache__/. Each holds the same 40-character literal as the old .py sources (sha256 prefix 53a3ee465671 in all three). The done-criterion's own command, `git ls-files | xargs grep msy_`, lists both files. The new tools/secret_scan.ts misses them because it searches with `git grep -I`, which skips binary files, so `npm run secrets` prints PASS. This fails done:9 and originality:F1. The other 9 done-criteria and the other 11 blocker and major items hold on fresh runs: overlay_regress cone PASS on all 4 tiers; the live Tunlan ultimate seen from the enemy side fills only the cone; recall VFX shows at every 0.5 s sample over the 6.87 s channel; each ultimate cast starts exactly one lift >= 1.3; render scale stays 1.0 through 16 s of the idle Home and 96 s of a real-client match, even at load 12-105; memory over 4 rebuilds stays flat (GPU +2.2 %); fog of war measures 0.537-0.542 on the display; wallmask has 0/48 spots under 50 %; probe_kit_hue measures >= 0.5 on all 32 slots; perf_1080 --prod reports GATE PASS (High 59.8 fps, p99 16.8 ms). Minor items: combat F4 is partly done (Rishal's ultimate still turns 60 % of the struck unit's box white), PERF-m4 and PERF-m5 are partly done as claimed, and the hue probe gave a false FAIL on a full 16-kit run. I looked at every new shot: none shows a horror face, a pointed hood, or a Wick with eyes.

src/render/renderer.ts:143 declares `listenerFocus(): { x: number; y: number }` on the Renderer interface, and :1239 returns { x: rig.focus.x, y: rig.focus.z }. camera.ts focus is the world ground point (focus.set(x, 0, z), and actors use root.position.set(x, h, y)), so this is the sim frame. W3 has wired it: src/boot/main.ts:75-77 calls ear.listener(() => focusOf.call(renderer)). typecheck is clean.

src/render/overlay/telegraphs.ts:93-99 sdSector returns `max(l, m * sign(c.x*p.y - c.y*p.x))` after p.y = abs(p.y). By hand, with r 9 and ha 25°: p = (4.5, 0) gives the side term -1.9 (inside), and p = (-4, 0) gives +1.69 (outside). Measured: see done:1, where the overlay_regress cone case passes on 4 tiers and the live enemy cone and 4 own aims are filled on the axis and empty beside and behind.

The 10 pipeline .py scripts read the key from the environment, exit cleanly when it is unset, and contain no literal (2a13a4dc). tools/secret_scan.ts is wired as `npm run secrets`, the first step of `npm run check`. But the same key literal is still in 2 tracked binary files at HEAD and on the pushed branch: pipeline/__pycache__/meshy_anims.cpython-313.pyc and meshy_chars_img.cpython-313.pyc. Any `strings` or `grep` on a clone recovers it, and the new scan cannot see binaries (git grep -I). Details are in done:9. The pre-commit hook was not installed (offered to the owner as optional), and git history is unchanged, which needs owner approval.
items.fixHint: Same as done:9: `git rm --cached pipeline/__pycache__/*.pyc`, then make secret_scan.ts include binary tracked files (no -I, byte-level match), commit, push and re-run both greps. Optionally add `*.pyc` to the scan's fixture so a planted binary key makes it FAIL.
